content:
Make better investment decisions with Simply Wall St's easy, visual tools that give you a competitive edge.

Veris Residential (VRE) has recently drawn attention after its share price moved to $18.86, with recent returns of 13% over the past month and 27% over the past 3 months.

See our latest analysis for Veris Residential.

That recent move to a share price of $18.86 sits within a stronger run, with a 30 day share price return of 13.4% and a 90 day share price return of 27.4%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 18.7% and 3 year total shareholder return of 36.3% suggest momentum has been building over a longer horizon.

If this kind of price action has your attention, it could be a good moment to scan for other opportunities and see what stands out in the 20 top founder-led companies

With Veris Residential trading at $18.86, slightly above an $18.00 analyst price target yet showing a small intrinsic discount of 3.3%, investors may need to consider whether there is still a buying opportunity or if the market is already accounting for future growth.

Price-to-Earnings of 24.6x: Is it justified?

Veris Residential is currently trading on a P/E of 24.6x, which sits below both its peer average of 46.4x and the North American Residential REITs average of 26.8x.

The P/E multiple compares the share price to earnings per share and is a quick way to see how much the market is paying for each dollar of profit. For a Residential REIT like Veris Residential that has only recently become profitable and carries a low 5.9% return on equity, this kind of earnings based yardstick can be a useful sense check on how the market is weighing current profitability against the earnings profile that is forecast to decline over the next 3 years.

On one hand, Veris Residential screens as good value versus peers on its 24.6x P/E. On the other hand, it also screens as expensive versus an estimated fair P/E of 15.4x that our fair ratio work suggests the market could gravitate towards over time. That tension between a relatively low earnings multiple compared to other Residential REITs and a premium to the fair ratio level is worth keeping in mind if you are weighing how much earnings power the current price is implicitly baking in.

À propos de Vanguard

Les Canadiens détiennent 192 milliards de dollars canadiens en actifs de Vanguard, y compris des FNB domiciliés au Canada et aux États-Unis ainsi que des fonds communs de placement canadiens. Placements Vanguard Canada Inc. gère un actif de 145 milliards de dollars canadiens (au 28 février 2026), actuellement réparti entre 38 FNB canadiens et 10 fonds communs de placement. The Vanguard Group, Inc. est l’une des plus importantes sociétés de gestion de placement au monde et un chef de file dans le domaine des services liés aux régimes de retraite d’employeur. Vanguard gère un actif de 12 300 milliards de dollars américains (16 700 milliards de dollars canadiens) à l’échelle mondiale, dont plus de 4 300 milliards de dollars américains (5 800 milliards de dollars canadiens) dans des FNB mondiaux (au 31 janvier 2026). Vanguard a des bureaux aux États-Unis, au Canada, au Mexique, en Europe et en Australie. La société offre 465 fonds, y compris des FNB, à plus de 50 millions d’investisseurs partout dans le monde.

Vanguard présente une structure opérationnelle unique. Contrairement aux sociétés cotées en bourse ou à celles détenues par un groupe restreint de particuliers, The Vanguard Group, Inc. appartient aux fonds et FNB de Vanguard domiciliés aux États-Unis. Ces fonds sont, à leur tour, détenus par les clients de Vanguard. Cette structure mutuelle unique permet de faire coïncider les intérêts de Vanguard avec ceux de ses investisseurs et façonne la culture, la philosophie et les politiques de Vanguard partout dans le monde. Les investisseurs canadiens profitent donc de la stabilité et de l’expérience de Vanguard, de ses placements à faibles coûts et de la priorité que la société accorde à sa clientèle. Pour obtenir plus de renseignements, veuillez visiter vanguard.ca.

Veris Residential, Inc. (NYSE: VRE)’s sale to an investor consortium led by Affinius Capital in partnership with Vista Hill Partners for $19.00 per share. If you are a Veris shareholder, click here to learn more about your rights and options.
